newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D drops as report raises online fears.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D drops as report raises online fears.

text.p: Shares in M.A.I.D Plc dropped on Monday after a press report said it had been denied access to a news database owned by Reuters Holdings Plc.
The stock was down 10-1/2p at 149-1/2 by 0945 GMT in volume of 150,170 shares.
The Financial Times said Reuters had stopped updating news stories on business databases operated by M.A.I.D and its larger rival Reed Elsevier.
The paper said M.A.I.D was understood to be setting up replacement agreements to carry news from the Times, the Sunday Times and BBC World Monitoring Service.

A spokesman for Reuters said Reuters' general policy was to renew agreements with distributors only where there was sufficient reciprocal content in return. He declined to comment specifically on M.A.I.D.
No-one at M.A.I.D was immediately available for comment.
